gloss: seafood; the bounty of the sea

definitions.gloss: seafood; the bounty of the sea
definitions.explanation: Fish, shellfish, seaweed and other food taken from the sea, spoken of as a gift of nature. Common in menus, travel writing and food advertising.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}の{幸|さち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧。
examples.english: To enjoy the bounty of the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{海|うみ}の{幸|さち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: This town has an abundance of seafood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧とれた{海|うみ}の{幸|さち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Dinner at the inn was laid out with plenty of local seafood.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海|うみ}の{幸|さち}{山|やま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幸|さち}→幸：28345_sachi⟧: the bounty of sea and mountains (a set pairing)
- {海|うみ}の{幸|さち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: dishes made with seafood
- ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な{海|うみ}の{幸|さち}: fresh seafood

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海産物|かいさんぶつ}→海産物：13394_kaisanbutsu⟧: marine products; the plain, commercial term
- ⟦{魚介類|ぎょかいるい}→魚介類：23435_gyokairui⟧: fish and shellfish; neutral, used in recipes and labels
{海|うみ}の{幸|さち} sounds warmer and is chosen to make food sound appealing.
